format: Team entries: OD-02 under-18 restriction per team member
requirement: Every individual team member must be evaluated under the OD-02 adult-only launch policy at team creation, registration, substitution and roster change; team-level validation is not sufficient.
enforcement_point: Not on this base (OD-02 is PR 835, OD-03/OD-18 are separate PRs). Per the PR 835 and OD-03 code, the public checkout route evaluates every participant in participantIds individually, so team members are covered at registration, and OD-03 covers every participant at confirmation. Gap: no application route changes a team roster after registration, but a studio manager can insert or update event_competition_entry_participants through the table API (competition_manage policy, all operations) with no age check; a roster substitution or staff-created entry therefore bypasses the gate. Needs a SQL guard (separate approval).
interpretation_notes: Evidence read from origin/od02-minors-restriction and origin/od03-age-eligibility-gate; those branches are not on this base, so no per-member test can run here. The date of birth is supplied in the registration draft and is self-declared, not verified.
